# khaledwaleed.com

> The personal site of Khaled Waleed, design engineer in Baghdad, Iraq.
> Hand-built: one public-domain painting per page, essays, a work history,
> and a living log of films.

## About

- Name: Khaled Waleed (Arabic: خالد وليد)
- Also spelled: Khalid Waleed · Khaled Walid · Khalid Walid
- Role: Design Engineer
- Location: Baghdad, Iraq
- Working at: Enjaz (enjaz.tech), Vitex (vitex.dev)
- Stack: SvelteKit, Nuxt, TypeScript, Go, PostgreSQL, Linux
- Email: contact@khaledwaleed.com

## Pages

- /: Home.
- /story: The full story, the work history, and the CV as a downloadable PDF.
- /projects: Everything built and shipped: products, client work, government platforms, open source.
- /writing: Essays and short fiction on people, ideas, art, and philosophy.
- /writing/r: Short fiction, a love letter transmitted from deep space.
- /writing/the-thin-line: How small the difference between a good person and a bad one really is.
- /writing/life-is-interesting: On meaning, and why we keep asking about it.
- /writing/sitting-in-discomfort-on-purpose: The small, private habit of voluntary difficulty.
- /likes: A catalogue of obsessions: cinema, music, art, style, food, philosophy.
- /films: Every film and series I have watched, scored 1 to 10.
- /tools: The hardware, software, and services in daily use, physical and digital.
- /contact: Phone, email, GitHub, LinkedIn, Telegram, Instagram, WhatsApp.
- /rss.xml: RSS feed for the writing.

## Style note

Each page is paired with one public-domain Northern Romantic painting
(Friedrich, Dahl, Daguerre, Wright of Derby). The site is set in Fraunces
and Libre Franklin, built with SvelteKit, and deployed on Cloudflare Pages.
